title: Oath and Wolf
author: Astrid Dravenmoor
blurb: Yara Montrose, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
